title: Adjunct Instructor - Finance - John Chambers College of Business and Economics
description:
The Department of Finance ( https://business.wvu.edu/academics/finance-department/finance
) at West Virginia University invites applications for part-time
Adjunct Instructor positions. Areas of need include undergraduate
and graduate courses in finance.

Qualifications :

The positions in finance require a master's or doctoral degree in
finance or a closely related discipline and evidence of ability to
teach effectively. Individuals with a doctoral degree are eligible
to teach graduate or undergraduate courses; individuals with only a
master's degree are eligible to teach undergraduate courses. A
combination of a bachelor's degree and at least 10 years of
professional experience in the finance industry may also be
considered for undergraduate teaching assignments.

Applications will be accepted throughout the year and will be
considered as openings arise. Salary is established on a per-course
basis. While these positions are not anticipated to be
benefits-eligible, individual positions may become
benefits-eligible based on course load - which may vary depending
on departmental need.

Please submit via PDF file (a) a letter of application summarizing
your teaching qualifications, (b) your curriculum vitae, and (c)
contact information for two individuals who can provide letters of
recommendation.
